business.name: Hyatt Centric French Quarter New Orleans

ranking.name: Hyatt Centric French Quarter New Orleans

text.text_excerpt: This place gets two reviews. This was the third location and hotel chain we stayed at in New Orleans. We are wondering why we didn't book all of our nights here, if we only knew. This is more of our type of hotel. We have achieved Hyatt Explorist level and are already reaping the benefits of that. Free high speed internet, bottles of water and best of all, we received a upgrade! Our room not only had a balcony that viewed the courtyard but we had a closet, refrigerator and a couch. I know that doesn't sound like much but the last place we stayed, didn't have any of those amenities. The other reviews will be just about the staff. Loved the staff, rooms are nice and the location is fantasti...

We stayed here on our 3 night stay in NOLA and I absolutely loved it! I've been to NOLA before and I knew how important it was to stay in the French Quarter and this location is ideal in the French quarter. It's around a block away from Bourbon Street where all the fun nightlife is and yet it's not right on it so you can actually sleep at night. My mom and I had a nice courtyard room that literally walks out onto the second floor courtyard which was absolutely gorgeous. We literally walked out every single day we were there, this beats a huge balcony any day of the week. So the location is perfect, the courtyard is gorgeous, the room is super spacious. We chose this hotel because we wanted to stay somewhere contemporary, but in the Quarter...not in the mood for old 1800's charm when it comes to where I sleep. Location: Fantastic. There are doors to the left of the lobby that go right out to Bourbon street and my favorite NOLA restaurant, Bourbon House is right in front of you. All the action is right there. Hotel: beautiful medium sized lobby all clean and contemporary. Only one set of 3 elevators so if your room isn't near them you could be taking a long, maze-like walk to your room.
